name: seedmesh-alpha
_comment: Bootstrap peers for the default swarm. FOUR OR MORE IS NOT COSMETIC: go-libp2p only accepts an observed public address after four distinct peers report it (identify/obsaddr.go, ActivationThresh = 4). Below that a NAT'd host never learns its own public address, never advertises anything dialable, and every connection falls back to a circuit relay -- which go-libp2p resets after 128 KiB, breaking any real model. See docs/NAT-AND-RELAYS.md.
